from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extraction of a single company's current asset metric from one report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if present, otherwise None")
    line_item_name: str = Field(description="Exact label of the asset item (e.g., '流动资产合计')")
    value_str: str = Field(description="The numeric amount as a string (e.g. '5,000,000,000.50')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g. '元')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    current_asset_records: list[CompanyAssetRecord]
